scope: Prospective observation-grid discrimination and same-session centered/boundary contrast; not ordinary START or physical quality qualification

selection.reasonPerLineRuleReplaced: Zero eligible of841commands at all-rival/both-edge .25; best minimum=.2495203876319465, not rounded upward
selection.jointRule: Each rival has both-edge abs fractional residual >=.25 on at least3of6; lexicographically first feasible set; legacyV2 additionally audited

contextBinding: Exact original geometry/DPI/client/shape/Size3/color-mode/black, unchanged view; fresh current-session blank capture with existing view/foreground/tool/cursor guards; no new calibration paint
gauge: Principal[-.5,.5) phases; jTop=round(g(top)-psiTop), jBottom=round(g(bottom)-psiBottom); integerSpan2 describes edge labels, not physical stamp rows
order: H1..H6 byY, Centered15 ascendingY, BoundaryControl16 ascendingY; no phase-conditioned retries or extra overdraw

measurement.shortBaseline: Individual fresh-before vs its after; trim16physicalpx at each end; every bodyX mandatory
measurement.blockBaseline: Fixed blank region stage-before vs each FULL cumulative prefix-after, NOT union of incremental masks
measurement.caps: Separately preserved/descriptive; never silently promoted to body or certified
measurement.meaning: Diagnostic observed edges, not Solid/requested-color coverage

decisions.complete: All37 linked nativepairs/traces, fresh baseline/confirmation/final and exact context/hash/order; all1123 expected sections in exact order; null/nonfinite/missing/duplicate/extra/disconnected/clipped -> INCOMPLETE before arithmetic

grid.candidateMetric: Median of ABSOLUTE UNWRAPPED expected-label residual over mandatorybodyX, separately for both edges on everyH; top=j,bottom=j+2
grid.rivalMetric: Median of nearest-integer ABSOLUTE residual over mandatorybodyX, separately for both edges on everyH; coefficients/phases fixed
grid.verdict: CONSISTENT if candidate allwithin and EVERY registered rival rejected on>=3lines; candidate violation -> CONTRADICTED; remaining ambiguity -> INCONCLUSIVE
grid.symmetry: Same median(abs(residual)) for candidate and rivals; never abs(median(signed)) or signedMedian <=positive limit

step.statistic: (mean bottom of final prefix - mean bottom of first prefix)/14 commanded row increments
step.denominator: 14 COMMAND increments under hypothesis; this is not a model-free independently counted physical row pitch
step.precision: No .01px measurement uncertainty established; +/-1% is a prospective research band only

increments.statistic: Mean bottom(prefix i)-mean bottom(prefix i-1), divided by FROZEN local classificationPitchPx perblock; first blank has no edge/increment
increments.endpoints: inclusive; disjoint gaps/negative/overshoot -> OUT_OF_CLASS, no rounding or dropping
verdicts: Centered zero/two -> CENTERING_PREDICTION_CONTRADICTED (does not exclude mapping/phase error or establish another cause)
Any OUT_OF_CLASS -> INCONCLUSIVE_UNRESOLVED_INCREMENT unless centered zero/two already contradicts
Centered allone and control >=1 zero/two -> CONSISTENT_WITH_PHASE_DEPENDENCE; not unique causal proof
increments.limitation: Blocks occupy differentY and sequential times; same-session control reduces session confound but does not eliminate position/time/stamp/observable alternatives

decisions.overall: Complete => MEASURED_NOT_QUALIFIED, separate grid/step/increment verdicts; no overallphysicalPASS; causal interpretation conditional on candidate/context validity

implementationBoundary: Existing contour runner/capture/guards; newoffgrid-* entry under same --standard-contour-pilot; oldPlane1 unchanged. Uses experimental CoreTexelGrid row-family API, no START/profile/targetdefault change.
